Mayhem

Country of origin:
Norway
Location:
Ski, Nordre Follo, Akershus (early); Oslo (later)
Status:
Active
Formed in:
1984
Genre:
Black Metal
Themes:
Satanism, Death, Gore (early); Misanthropy, War, Darkness, Philosophy (later)
Current label:
Century Media Records
Years active:
1984 (as Musta), 1984-1993, 1994-present
Pictured from left to right: Necrobutcher, Ghul, Attila Csihar, Teloch, and Hellhammer.

The band was billed as Wolf's Lair Abyss for a few secret gigs during the Wolf's Lair Abyss tour.

Founded by Jørn Stubberud (Necrobutcher), and Kjetil (Manheim) under the name Musta (Finnish for "black"), which they changed to Mayhem after Øystein Aarseth (Euronymous) joined in. The band name is taken from ...
